patch_description: Instead of stochastic annealing, use constrained nonlinear optimization (SLSQP) to directly maximize the minimum pairwise distance: after normalizing so dmax = 1, we solve max t subject to ||pi-pj||² ≥ t² for all 91 pairs with t ≤ 1, providing analytic constraint Jacobians. This is a smooth, principled local solver that converges to true local optima of the spread problem rather than a random-walk basin. Applied from a diverse family of structured seeds (Fibonacci sphere, cuboctahedron+poles sweep, icosahedron+poles sweeps, staggered heptagon rings, fixed-seed random configs), it reliably reaches (and often exceeds) the reference configuration ratio of ~0.49, whereas annealing was stuck near 0.48.
